messages.subject: For Dastan Kosherbayev | Government relations, uranium and international development
messages.body:
Dear Government Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Dastan Kosherbayev, Chief Strategy and International Development Officer.

Kazatomprom's global position in uranium places government alignment, strategic partnerships, international development and institutional credibility at the center of long-term growth. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today at the intersection of mining operations, public institutions, ESG and executive management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior engagement with ministries, regulators, communities and industry stakeholders, translate external commitments into accountable operating owners, and coordinate complex issues across legal, environment, HSE, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around a significant solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Kazatomprom's government-relations, international-development, stakeholder or strategic-partnership priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kazatomprom.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
